name: Simulator: S05 lists the webhook events Stripe sent for it, per timeline event, with their invoice and subscription status
description: FR10, R24. For S05 (subscribe 01-01, upgrade 01-17, timeline ends on the 02-01 renewal) a Stripe test clock sent: event 1 invoice.created/finalized/paid for invoice 1 and customer.subscription.created (active); event 2 two invoiceitem.created and customer.subscription.updated (active); event 3 only invoice.created for invoice 2 and customer.subscription.updated (active), because Stripe finalizes a renewal an hour later.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page, click 'Simulator' in the top navigation bar, and choose 'S05' in the 'Load scenario' dropdown
Below the invoices, click 'Webhook events Stripe sends (9)' to expand it
Assert the group 'Event 1' lists invoice.created, invoice.finalized and invoice.paid each with '→ invoice 1', and customer.subscription.created with '(active)'
Assert the group 'Event 2' lists invoiceitem.created exactly twice and customer.subscription.updated '(active)' once, all dated 2027-01-17
Assert the group 'Event 3' lists exactly two events: invoice.created '→ invoice 2' and customer.subscription.updated '(active)', both dated 2027-02-01, and no invoice.paid for invoice 2
